conviction_note: Leans slightly positive and is near zero. The guidance looks beatable: the H1 guide of OP 720m implies Q2 OP of only about 150m, against 265m a year ago and 570m in Q1. The FY guide of 1,250m implies Q2-Q4 of 680m, against 902m last year. But the street (kabuyoho, FY OP 1,500m, H1 ordinary 710m) is already above the company. This name paid +1.4% for a 48% H1 OP raise in July. It has been pinned near the 2,006 warrant strike for three months on 6% realised vol. The 12:00 mid-term plan, co-drafted with Advantage Partners, is the unknown that sets the size, and its sign is unknown. So abs_move is 2.0 at p_up 55, while impact_sum is +0.5. The two numbers agree in sign and differ in scale only because the plan finding is sized 0.

findings.finding: The July-revised H1 guide (OP 720m) implies Q2 (Jun-Aug) OP of about 150m, against 265m in the same quarter a year ago and 570m in Q1. Both segments roughly doubled profit in Q1 (food 402m vs 242m, restaurants 325m vs 163m), so an H1 OP print above 720m is more likely than not.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-07-14 the company raised H1 OP 48% (485m to 720m) together with a Q1 at 2.4x. The stock went 2,029 to 2,058 the next session (+1.4%, Yahoo chart), drifted to 2,085 by 07-29 and gave it back by 08-04. Baseline median absolute reaction 1.63% over 11 estimated prints.
findings.why_not_priced: The implied-Q2 arithmetic is public. The street's H1 ordinary of 710m sits only 40m above the company's 670m, so the street has not marked H1 much above guide. If the market expected a large H1 beat, the stock would have run into the print. Instead it has been flat at ~2,010 for a month. Partly priced at most.
findings.independence: Segment detail from the company's Q1 deck https://www.eat-and.jp/ir/upload_file/m004-m004_01/20271QIR.pdf (2026-07-14). Same underlying numbers, so this is one finding, not two.

findings.finding: The FY guide (OP 1,250m, held in July) needs only 680m over Q2-Q4, against 902m in the same nine months last year. Q1 alone was 45.6% of the full-year OP plan, against about 21% at Q1 last year. An FY upward revision with the H1 print is plausible, but the street already sits at OP 1,500m. Management also has a stated reason to hold: Kyushu factory startup costs, with completion in December and operation in Feb-Mar 2027, plus Middle East cost uncertainty.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last FY guide line was 2026-07-14, FY held while H1 was raised: +1.4% the next session. Earlier 修正 history is behind kabutan's paywall.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The consensus of OP 1,500m already assumes a raise, so a raise to about 1,400-1,500 only meets the street. The unpriced part is a raise above 1,500 (upside) or a hold at 1,250 (mild downside). Both are possible, with an edge to a raise given Q1's 45.6% progress. If the market were confident of a large raise, the stock would not be sitting at the July level.
findings.independence: Kyushu factory timing and cost: Nihon Shokuryo Shimbun 2026-04-27 https://news.nissyoku.co.jp/news/yamamoto20260422021034059 (cuts against the raise and is already reflected in the size). Q1 progress: https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=2882

findings.finding: The new five-year mid-to-long-term plan (FY2028/2 to FY2032/2) is released at 12:00 JST today, inside the session. It was re-drafted after the July postponement together with Advantage Partners, which committed ¥3.0bn through the 9th-series warrants (1,495,500 shares, 11.62%, initial exercise price ¥2,006, floor ¥1,805). The previous plan's FY2027/2 targets (OP ¥2.5bn, ROE 8%, EPS ¥100) were missed and revised down in April 2026. The content, and any capital-policy change (dividend policy, 株主優待), is unknown, so it is sized at zero with a wide band.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior plan release in the window on record. The July alliance and warrant announcement came at 17:00 on 2026-07-14 alongside the H1 raise; the next session was +1.4% combined.
findings.why_not_priced: The date is public; the content is not. Its sign cannot be inferred from what is public. A PE-shaped plan could bring ambitious profit and ROE targets or a richer payout (positive), or a 優待 rationalisation (negative for this retail register). No source points either way, so it moves abs_move, not the sum.
findings.independence: AP alliance and warrant terms: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260714593416.pdf and https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260803/140120260803506415.pdf (same corporate action).

outside_window.finding: The 9th-series warrant exercise price resets on 2027-02-03 to the 20-day average close if lower (floor ¥1,805). That creates a dated dilution and price-sensitivity point for AP's ¥3bn commitment, after the window.
The Kyushu (Miyakonojo) factory, about ¥6.6bn and about 1,300t/month capacity, completes in Dec 2026 and starts operating Feb-Mar 2027. Startup costs and depreciation land in Q4 and FY2028/2.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: H1 already raised in July. An FY raise is possible (Q1 = 45.6% of FY OP, and the guide implies Q2-Q4 down 25% YoY), but the street is already at OP 1,500 against the plan's 1,250, so only a raise past 1,500 or a hold is news. Returns: the interim dividend of 7.5 yen was fixed on 2026-09-29, unchanged; any policy change would come in the 12:00 plan, content unknown. New-year guide: not this print, but the five-year plan is released today. Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q1 OP was 83.6% of the H1 guide, against 48.6% and 51.7% in the prior two years; the implied Q2 is far below last year's 265m.
baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive and agree with the tiny priced lean (+0.02) and the flat run-up (-0.1%). The strongest positive the release could carry is an FY raise above the street's 1,500m together with a payout upgrade in the AP-drafted plan; I looked and found no sourced hint of either. The strongest negative is an FY hold at 1,250m with a 優待 cut, also unsourced.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 / open question 3: the H1-beat finding rests on a progress rate anyone can compute from the July 短信, after a July 修正 that partly pre-released H1. Cut from +0.4 to +0.3.
